editor.title: Links into your editor
editor.intro: A changed file or a worktree gets a link that opens it in your editor. These settings are kept in this browser, because the editor runs on this machine and the server cannot know how to reach it.
editor.templateHint: {path}, {line} and {column} are filled in. For VS Code: vscode://file/{path}:{line}. For Cursor: cursor://file/{path}:{line}.
editor.diffCommandHint: Adds a button that copies this command with {left} and {right} filled in: the file in the main checkout and the file in the worktree. A browser cannot run it for you, so paste it in a terminal.
editor.pathMapHint: When Agentry runs in a container, the paths it reports are the container's. Each row rewrites a directory to where it is on this machine. The first row that matches wins.

problem.scheme: The template has to start with a scheme your system opens, such as vscode://.
problem.unsafe: That scheme is not allowed: a link that runs script or opens a file inside the page is never built.
problem.path: The template has no {path}, so it could not say which file to open.

editor.openAtLine: Open {{path}} at line {{line}} in the editor

changes.title: Changes
changes.nothing: Nothing changed yet: no commits and no edited files.
changes.emptyDiff: There is no text difference to show for this file.
changes.noWorktree: This graph does not give each worker its own worktree, so there is no branch to compare. Start a graph with worktrees to see what each worker changed.
changes.touchedIntro: This chat is not in a git worktree of its own, so the files it wrote are read from its transcript.
changes.nothingTouched: This chat has not written any file.

checklist.title: Its checklist
checklist.none: It has not written a checklist.

health.title: Health
health.cancelBody: Only this command's processes are stopped. The turn goes on: the worker gets a failed result for the command and decides what to do next.
health.hintExplained: Written for this signal; edit it before sending. It is added to what the worker is doing now, and the worker carries on.
health.interruptHint: Interrupts the turn that is running. The chat stays open and waits for what you send next.

activity.title: Doing now
activity.thinking: No command is running: it is thinking or writing.
activity.lastEvent: Last event in the transcript {{time}} ago.

task.title: Work of {{name}}
task.notStarted: This task has not started, so it has done nothing yet.
